content: Table TABREF33 describes the results obtained in the user study: the mean and standard deviation of percentage of answers in agreement with our model, the p-value, and the number of MTurk workers who completed each task. We find that the average agreement of human evaluators with our model is 70.40% over all 15 users in our dataset.
